ownKinds.inUse.cards: The card kind "{gone}" is used in {count} places, so it cannot be removed ({places}). Delete those cards or change them to another kind first
ownKinds.inUse.lines: The line kind "{gone}" is used in {count} places, so it cannot be removed ({places}). Remove those lines from the cards first
ownKinds.inUse.sections: The section kind "{gone}" is used in {count} places, so it cannot be removed ({places}). Delete those sections first
ownKinds.inUse.via: The via value "{gone}" is used in {count} places, so it cannot be removed ({places}). Change the via of those nodes to another value or clear it first
ownKinds.kinds.keyNotAllowed: kinds cannot have "{key}" (only cards, sections, lines, project_tree, contexts, icons and vias can be written)
ownKinds.kinds.notList: {key} in kinds is an array of definitions
ownKinds.kinds.shape: kinds is {cards: [...], sections: [...], lines: [...]} (the shape is in guide, about: kind_create)
ownKinds.rename.fieldHasValue: {said}: {name} has a value in the field {to}, so {from} cannot be moved (remove one of them first)
ownKinds.rename.fieldStillDefined: {said}: the definition of {kind} still has the field {from} (to rename it, change the field's name in the definition to {to} too)
ownKinds.rename.isBuiltin: {said}: {from} is a built-in kind, so it cannot be renamed
ownKinds.rename.keyNotAllowed: renames[{i}]: "{key}" cannot be written (only kind, field, row and to, or top_section and to, can be)
ownKinds.rename.kindStillDefined: {said}: {from} is still in the definitions (to rename it, change kind in the definition to {to} too)
ownKinds.rename.kindToNeeded: renames[{i}]: kind and to (the new name) are required. {shape}
ownKinds.rename.noFieldTo: {said}: the definition of {kind} has no field {to}
ownKinds.rename.noKindTo: {said}: the definitions have no card kind {to}
ownKinds.rename.noOwnKind: {said}: the definitions have no project card kind {kind}
ownKinds.rename.noRow: {said}: the definition of {kind} has no row kind {row}
ownKinds.rename.noRowFieldTo: {said}: the definition of {row} in {kind} has no field {to}
ownKinds.rename.noRowTo: {said}: the definition of {kind} has no row kind {to}
ownKinds.rename.rowFieldHasValue: {said}: a row of {name} has a value in the field {to}, so {from} cannot be moved (remove one of them first)
ownKinds.rename.rowFieldStillDefined: {said}: the definition of {row} in {kind} still has the field {from}
ownKinds.rename.rowHasRow: {said}: {name} has the row {to}, so {from} cannot be moved (remove one of them first)
ownKinds.rename.rowStillDefined: {said}: the definition of {kind} still has the row kind {from} (change the row's name in the definition to {to} too)
ownKinds.rename.shape: renames is an array of renames: {"kind": "<kind>", "to": "<new name>"} (a card kind), {"kind": "<kind>", "field": "<field>", "to": …} (a field), {"kind": "<kind>", "row": "<row kind>", "to": …} (a row kind), {"kind": "<kind>", "row": "<row kind>", "field": "<row field>", "to": …} (a row's field), {"top_section": "<section directly under the root>", "to": …} (a project_tree section; its contents and lines stay as they are). kind is the name in the new definitions
ownKinds.rename.topSectionKey: renames[{i}]: "{key}" cannot be written with top_section (only top_section and to can be)
ownKinds.rename.topSectionNeeded: renames[{i}]: top_section (the current name) and to (the new name) are required
ownKinds.set.invalid:
Not changed, as the kind definitions have errors:
{problems}
ownKinds.tree.needed: To rename a top_section, give project_tree too. {shape}
ownKinds.view.ofShape: of is one of cards, sections, lines, project_tree (an array for several)
ownKinds.view.ofUnreadable: of cannot read "{wrong}" (one of cards, sections, lines, project_tree)
